# iEEG

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(rprojroot)

proj_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file_pattern("\\.Rproj$"))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = proj_root)
```

## Functions

```{r}
source("analysis/06_ieeg/pearson_utils.R")
```

## Input

```{r}
behavior_csv <- "data/06_ieeg/behavior_ieeg.csv"
feature_MTGR_csv <- "data/06_ieeg/feature/ieeg_MTGR.csv"

out_fig <- "figures/06_ieeg/MTGR.pdf"

dir.create(dirname(out_fig), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Load data

```{r}
feature_df_MTGR <- read_csv(
  feature_MTGR_csv,
  locale = readr::locale(encoding = "UTF-8"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

be_df <- read_csv(
  behavior_csv,
  locale = readr::locale(encoding = "UTF-8"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

## Plot MTGR

```{r}
condition_pick <- "Voluntary_OutcomeOnsetReportSound"

map_df <- tibble::tibble(
  subject = c("2", "4"),
  label   = c("chan83-chan84", "chan10-chan11")
)

fill_vals <- c(
  "10-11" = "#02c39a",
  "83-84" = "#ff758f"
)

shape_vals <- c(
  "10-11" = 21,
  "83-84" = 24
)

p_MTGR <- plot_half_violin_subjects(
  behavior_df = be_df,
  feature_df  = feature_df_MTGR,
  condition_pick = condition_pick,
  map_df = map_df,
  subjects_order = c("4", "2"),
  fill_vals = fill_vals,
  point_shapes = shape_vals,
  itpc_cols = c(Delta = "Delta_bandITPC", Theta = "Theta_bandITPC"),
  y_limits = c(-200, 600),
  y_breaks = c(-200, 0, 200, 400, 600),
  point_size = 2.8,
  point_alpha = 0.72,
  point_nudge = -0.12,
  jitter_width = 0.15,
  summary_nudge = 0.13,
  range_cap_width = 0.18
)

p_MTGR
```

## Save

```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = out_fig,
  plot = p_MTGR,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  device = cairo_pdf,
  family = "Arial",
  bg = "white"
)

cat("Saved:\n", out_fig, "\n")
```
